title: Rock Paper Scissors
description: Adds a rock paper scissors minigame to your server, with rewards for the winner!
body:
## How it works:
Put the jar files in the plugin folder of the server, and when you join you must have a rock paper scissors item in the inventory, right clicking will prompt you to choose, and once chosen, the other player will get the option to choose (this will only work with 2 players).

### **Common Rewards (75% chance):**
- Iron tools and armor with enchantments
- Cooked Beef (random quantity between 5 and 8)

### **Rare Rewards (3% chance):**
- Diamond tools and armor with enchantments

### **Ultra Rare Rewards (1% chance):**
- Netherite tools with enchantments

### **Other Rewards (Remaining probability):**
- Ender Pearls x 6
- Golden Apple x 4
- Golden Carrot x 6
- Bow with enchantment
- Arrows x 80
- Gold Ingots (random quantity between 6 and 21)
- Iron Ingots (random quantity between 10 and 34)
- XP Bottle (random quantity between 2 and 4)
- Crossbow
